admission: Before each effect preadmit full logical read/write upper bound, retained input/output/parser work, process start and metadata structure. API outputs use maximum bytes and bounded members/depth. Fixed per-stage reservations must fit original complete limits, including min two arm starts, initial probes, all exchange headers/bodies and cleanup; insufficient profile refuses before starting.
arm: The development worker, its new server and all model-directed tool descendants consume that condition's one original protected arm ceiling. Exactly one worker spawn plus one server spawn and every reached tool child are precharged process starts; no hidden server allowance. Workspace/cache preparation uses the preselected arm share, while H's separate overhead stays host.
before_seed: The independently selected static subject/policy/profile/plan preparation predates this H route and retains its actual earlier root owner, source qualification and complete original cost evidence. It is neither free nor silently assigned to a future H Share. Every H read/authentication/runtime bootstrap-attestation/publication and source admission is charged to the already live ParentCustody.share before seed attachment. At attach, its entire actual spent prefix belongs to host and must fit host_subshare minus terminal reserve; no H interval, constructor or traversal is uncharged. Missing earlier root ownership/qualification is a refusal.
clock: All original clock mapping/entry origin/run/evidence cutoffs persist. Actual S and D give R=S+D, with original latest+D launch bound; require selected I+Q<D. G=R-Q and J=min(S+I,G). Initialization and H ack, generation through G, planned server close and worker publication/exit through R fit in the same protected duration. H terminal capture alone may use original E. No ready-time reset, deadline extension, compensating duration or extra shutdown allowance. Both arms use the same I,Q,D and ceilings.
cost_transfer: RootResources adopts the same EarlyOwner/Share/counter/span objects. Exact earlier charges, live spans, unknown dimensions, process owners and later reporting/cleanup continue. Final RootPlan still contains the original early row once; no snapshot cloning or reset.
current_phase: BUILD ONLY. No profile capacity measured, no executable/model opened, no child/server/native/network runtime exercised. Future capacity/source/native controls require independent explicit selection.
errors: Fixed parent/worker/backend owners retain exact first raw exception before any formatting, clock, diagnostic or cleanup. Secondary raw errors are ordered. Unknown spawn/read/write/identity/clock/final statistics remain unknown, never0. Descriptor close slots clear before ambiguous close, no unsafe retry/reused descriptor closure. Cleanup of other owned handles continues independently; missing publication cannot destroy private failure custody.
fairness: Both immutable views/exposures precede first worker launch; same backend/model/tokenizer/template/sampling/caps and equal arm allocations. Distinct actual mutable roots/processes. Reference or A cannot borrow B, H cannot consume terminal reserve, successful early exit does not grant later retries. One failed/unknown initialization/ack/exchange/closure makes both seals ineligible.
host: H source/issuer/creator work, preparation orchestration, each actual capture/readback, group observations, server-admission verification/ack, reporting and H cleanup use the same host subshare; terminal capacity stays protected. H CPU is not relabeled child CPU.
physical: The existing whole original H+A+B+descendants hard envelope remains. Arm cgroup CPU/memory/pids/storage aggregate includes server and tools once; do not sum child CPU again into the same group CPU. H/worker physical observations and logical read/write reservations remain distinct. Server HTTP thread-pool dynamics are bounded by the independent native pids/memory profile, not by --threads-http alone.

programme_output_current_composition.prior_text: V1 operative bodies and the full final peer are immutable history, not competing current clauses.
programme_output_current_composition.wire_continuity: Original102 and all12 ProgrammeOutputV1 record bodies plus ProgrammeArgument remain exactly unchanged. ProgrammeOutputV2 adds DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure, HStreamSideV1 and HStreamCaptureV1 plus exact existing CostPrefix/clock/owner/caller relations. Existing schema literals are not a version fallback.

H_cost_observation.capacity: This is the already-required cost_observation publication, under original metadata/request/write/readback/retention/cost reserves. Count every actual occurrence/repeated reader; unknown full cumulative cost remains unknown. No new budget or synthetic cost reconciliation.
H_cost_observation.consumer: PairCompletionHandle.require_original and later complete target admission require the exact same-owner aggregate occurrence/capture and original source/clock ancestry. Decode the existing closed CostPrefix body, not a new cost schema or nominally similar record. Metadata equality alone is insufficient.
H_cost_observation.occurrence: The actual original attempt.cost_observation is the completed same-owner CapturedRecord(kind=CostPrefix) from that defined pre-Completion occurrence. Its Pin is assigned exactly to DevelopmentCompletion.cost_observation. If both arms capture separate occurrences, each is an observation of the same aggregate owner at its own original position, not an independent arm charge; neither prefix is added to the other. No sharing is inferred without an actual same captured occurrence/owner proof.
H_cost_observation.prefix_time: This prefix includes known earlier actual H/A/B effects, including prior completed raw stream/manifest and workspace evidence. It never claims the future cost of its own serialization/write/readback/close or the later Completion/pair/capture/assembly. Those later actual costs and failures stay on the same H/outside observations, not invented zeroes.
H_cost_observation.producer: Same original H owner captures its actual aggregate H+A+B CostPrefix occurrence after the earlier successful original lifecycle/workspace/stream evidence and before the corresponding DevelopmentCompletion publication. Use the existing source-owned aggregate producer, never an arm-local counter or a sum of already cumulative prefix records.
H_cost_observation.success: All original CostPrefix fields and unknown/unfinished semantics remain unchanged. Preserve truthful failed/unknown prefixes on the original owner. Actual unknown_dimensions/unavailable measured dimensions or original error state cannot qualify DevelopmentCompletion completeness; no filtering or resetting before capture. unfinished_span records the still-active original H accounting span and its actual original active origins; it is not by itself an unknown measurement or permission to stop/end/renew H early. Do not force it false before later Completion/capture work and do not claim a final whole-host total from this live prefix.

H_stream_capture.close_chronology: Each side has an actual successful positive-size EOF observation and once-only pipe-close return. Set the original owned slot to closed immediately after that successful return, before reading the following original-H close timestamp. If the clock read fails, retain closed state and that raw failure; no complete HStreamSideV1 exists and do not retry close or replace closed_ns with zero. A failed/ambiguous close retains original unknown/attempted ownership and also cannot produce a complete side.
H_stream_capture.failure_and_caps: Unknown byte counts, missing EOF, forced/unknown close, raw failure or incomplete captured body remains existing original failure evidence, never a successful manifest with zero/empty substitutes. Preserve original stream transfer caps and their original combined/per-side meaning exactly. All raw files/readbacks/manifest, retained raw buffers, fd/clock/cleanup and repeated readers must fit the same predeclared original H/arm shares and file limits; no extra allowance, live-pipe reread, recapture or source expansion.
H_stream_capture.private_inverse: Within the existing finish_pair_backend_v1 lifecycle, only the actual same-owner CapturedRecord(kind=HStreamCaptureV1) over both original closed slots fills attempt.complete_stream_capture. DevelopmentCompletion.complete_stream_capture is exactly that capture.pin. PairCompletionHandle.require_original and programme/output admission verify the original attempt, condition, owner_binding, two exact earlier raw captures, full typed side positions and timestamps. No equal dictionary/Pin grants authority.
H_stream_capture.publication_order: After both actual stream sides have known complete raw prefixes/EOF and known close timestamps, publish/read back exact stdout raw bytes first, then stderr raw bytes; only then publish/read back HStreamCaptureV1. Its observed_ns is the actual original H observation after both raw captures and before manifest publication, within E. It has no future DevelopmentCompletion or own publication Pin/cost. Every publication attempt is retained before the effect; failed stderr or manifest publication retains the completed stdout prefix and forbids success/retry.
H_stream_capture.side_inverse: stdout.name=stdout and stderr.name=stderr, exactly one of each. Each HStreamSideV1.raw_bytes Pin is the actual completed same-H raw capture; side.bytes and side.sha256 equal that Pin and the exact observed raw bytes. Preserve bytes exactly, including zero-length streams; no Unicode decoding, newline normalization, invented padding or omission.
H_stream_capture.source_owner: Same actual original H DevelopmentAttemptHandle and original owned stdout/stderr pipe slots, original observation/EOF/once-only-close custody and retained raw bytes. A backend server StreamClosureObservation or parsed stream manifest cannot substitute for the H worker streams.

programme_output_v2.clock: P01-P17 consume the original H evidence interval E, never worker-ready/G/R reset or a new postdevelopment allowance. Full pair natural closure already completed within the selected original worker interval; capture/assembly and all original H terminal obligations must fit E. Exact original owner.check before effects; elapsed/unknown time never turns into0.

closure_capacity_inverse.already_required_population: Exactly one DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure per actual original H arm before its DevelopmentCompletion; this is the same required descendant_and_workspace_closure publication, not a new normal effect.
closure_capacity_inverse.closed_size: Exactly11 fields. Pin and OwnedPathIdentity/CostPrefix remain original closed domains. Complete encoded body, decoded retention, depth/member count and all actual repeated consumer reads must fit original M/plan/profile; reject full body before effect if not. No duplicated subtree member array or inline arbitrary object.
closure_capacity_inverse.later_effects: cost_prefix is an earlier prefix only. Closure publication, later retained-anchor lifetime/capture/assembly and terminal cleanup are charged by actual original H/outside observations; no future/self-write cost claim or extra cap.
closure_capacity_inverse.request_owner: Original H pays actual observer/identity capture and closure write/readback plus every actual typed reread. Full existing original closure/read profiles remain additive to the unchanged new programme producer formula; missing bounded counts/refused envelope remain unavailable.

derived_bounds.argv: each job1..128 exact typed arguments; Text<=4096 scalar characters plus checked encoded length<=M, every source/inherited/tool index exact and in bounds
derived_bounds.each_source_file_bytes: S=min(ConstructionPlan.maximum_input_bytes,ConstructionPlan.maximum_output_bytes); each declared extent<=S; actual stat extent plus positive1 EOF/overflow request must be separately preadmitted under same original remaining read budget
derived_bounds.jobs: complete original candidate roster,1..8192 and within every applicable metadata member bound; never truncate to a cap
derived_bounds.manifest_and_each_new_record_bytes: M=min(ConstructionPlan.maximum_input_bytes, ConstructionPlan.maximum_output_bytes, DevelopmentProfile.maximum_metadata_bytes); exact positive integers, no independent ABI number or inferred descriptor extent substitutes for request limit
derived_bounds.metadata_structure: depth<=min(64,ConstructionPlan.maximum_depth); every complete serialized tree and parser has at most ConstructionPlan.maximum_members members and exact selected byte cap M; source path component depth obeys same depth limit
derived_bounds.source_file_count: F=min(8192,ConstructionPlan.maximum_members,DevelopmentProfile.maximum_files); original total workspace file count including all preexisting members/control outputs/new source/manifest also<=DevelopmentProfile.maximum_files

programme_output_v2.failure_and_cleanup: Retain raw first before clock/cost/format/attachment; register every FD/directory/capture before fstat/encoder/IO, close each owned slot once independently, clear before ambiguous close, continue remaining closes. Preserve partial output/provisional/unknown phases and exact actual observed byte prefix. Never delete/rewrite prior captured evidence or retry a failed attempt; no fabricated successful capture/failure Pin. Failure of diagnostic/cost/close stays secondary; later completion is ineligible.

finite_new_effect_roster.extent_accounting: These are requested byte ceilings, not fictional returned bytes. A stat-verified extent L may reserve L+1 only with a source-owned serial reservation/settlement proof; otherwise reserve the full above ceiling. Positive probe returns0 at EOF; growth returns at most one charged overflow byte and refuses. Failed/unknown reservations are not released. No zero-budget probe.
finite_new_effect_roster.finite_arithmetic: All counts/sums/products use checked exact nonnegative integers within original UInt; overflow or a combined new+old+failure/terminal envelope that does not fit refuses before effects. Native CPU/RSS/IO feasibility is never inferred from these logical bounds.
finite_new_effect_roster.later_programme_reads: All existing downstream source/import/native/scientific read profiles remain in the original complete plan. Missing full declared census/repetition/required output producer prevents final admission; the new normal formula cannot substitute for a whole-programme allocation.
finite_new_effect_roster.metadata_and_directory_effects: The complete directory metadata roster is bounded by the earlier captured preexisting inventory plus at most2*F*min(64,plan.maximum_depth) new source ancestor entries, two fixed manifests, and all exact fixed private-control entries. Each actual list/fstat/open/close/clock/hash/parse/encoder action reserves original work/retention/cost before effect. Missing bounded syscall/native cost qualification remains a gate, not zero cost. Full source and new metadata publication lengths are checked before writes against original M/S caps.

normal_capture_per_arm.effect: P03 captured original manifest publication plus readback
P05 each source original read plus captured-file publication/readback

finite_new_effect_roster.reader_repetition: The above covers exactly the new producer effects, not later admission. P17 must predeclare every actual read occurrence from the original source caller plus new fixed nominal target reads: source manifest and capture receipt per arm, assembler receipt, full final census, same earlier policy/capture ABI/development contract/selection/template as required by identity comparisons. Each occurrence reserves its actual selected reader cap+1 and decoded/retained work; all original output-contract/seal/completion/pair/backend/public/interface/paired-view/source-producer reads remain separately counted. Deduplication is allowed only for an implemented source-owned earlier authenticated body cache with same owner/root/Pin/type; never merely because Pins repeat.

original_completion_effects.exact_requests: Before effects, reserve each raw publication/write/readback for its complete already observed raw extent and original positive EOF/readback request as applicable; retain the same original stream cap semantics and unknown reservations. Each of the three typed metadata bodies is bounded by original M/depth/member/file limits. Actual per-record repetitions and full pipeline file count must include all these physical files. No reuse or removal of existing charged evidence is inferred.
original_completion_effects.full_plan: Predeclare all raw, metadata, later typed readers, prefix publication and terminal costs under unchanged original H/A/B shares. Missing/full-overcap inventory remains refusal; no added capacity or borrowed protected reserve.
original_completion_effects.per_original_arm: Two exact raw stream file captures/readbacks in stdout then stderr order; one HStreamCaptureV1 manifest capture/readback; one DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure and one aggregate CostPrefix capture/readback at their defined original pre-Completion positions. All existing underlying stream/subtree/identity/clock observations remain separately charged. These type existing required completion evidence and are not included in the unchanged new programme-capture formula.
original_completion_effects.readonly_evidence: Raw stdout/stderr captured bytes are protected original-H evidence; only their exact Pins are in the manifest. No participant/public exposure or newly authorized authentic/model body read follows.

original_cutoff_field.consumer: PairCompletionHandle.require_original, the fixed ProgrammeCapture.capture_pair_v3, ProgrammeAssembler.assemble_v3 and later serialized output-contract admission verify these same-owner equalities against the actual earlier captures and their source-qualified ancestry. A valid UInt or repeated equal dictionaries cannot supply the original H owner. Missing/mismatched E refuses before dependent capture/promotion; retain raw failure on the already registered original owner.
original_cutoff_field.earlier_operand: The exact same original H owner retained evidence deadline E: PairCompletionHandle.pair.owner.parent.original_deadline in the selected source snapshot. It is established before preparation and launch; it is not derived from a later completion or fresh clock.
original_cutoff_field.failure_and_cost: A clock/identity/consumer mismatch preserves first raw error, all earlier attempted reservations/effects, partial captures, unknown dimensions and once-only independent cleanup on the same original H. No recapture, replacement attempt, fresh deadline, refund or worker continuation. Cost/time snapshots remain prepublication; later actual publication/cleanup stays on H/outside observation.
original_cutoff_field.intervals: Original S,J,G,R,L,common_cutoff and original run deadline keep their full existing derivations and obligations. Natural worker/server stopping and original worker publications must finish within their respective R/G/J constraints. H DevelopmentCompletion.closed_ns and later capture/receipt/seal/assembly observations may exceed R only after actual complete stopping/closure and while <= the unchanged E. Every actual owner.check keeps its original stricter operational predicate; this field relation does not relax it.
original_cutoff_field.phase_order: Earlier preparation/launch need only the already-retained original H E and their original prerequisites, never a future pair completion or seal. Later successful pair closure and ProgrammeCapture occur only after actual full original paired closure. No new blanket completion/seal prerequisite is inserted into earlier phases.
original_cutoff_field.producer: DevelopmentOwner.finish_pair_backend_v1 assigns original_cutoff_ns = that exact retained E when publishing the already-required DevelopmentPairClosure-v3 after both actual completed original arms. No additional publication, deadline or owner is created.
required_equalities: each earlier original arm launch.body.evidence_deadline_ns == original_H.original_deadline

programme_output_v2.phase_status: Design only; bounds are declared source obligations, not measured filesystem/native feasibility. No real profile, source inventory, data/model, syscall or numerical control is exercised here.
programme_output_v2.physical_costs: H pays every real capture, source-copy, manifest/receipt/seal/census write/readback/parse/hash/inventory/observation through its same original host share; earlier worker source writes/tool descendants already consume their original arm allocation. Later repeated reads are new physical charges. Capturing a previously written source file does not erase earlier arm costs. Preserve actual returned bytes separately from positive read reservation; EOF returns0, unknown failed reads keep original uncertain reservation.
programme_output_v2.preflight: Before first H capture effect, derive full two-arm worst-case requests, raw/parser/encoder/source-copy/metadata retention, directory entries, file/control/publication counts, write/readback/fsync/close and failed-prefix capacities from original finite M/S/F/J bounds and actual earlier inventories. Preflight cannot assume both arms small/successful or refund failed/unknown reservations. If only a safe conservative envelope is known and it does not fit, refuse. No new budget/profile or terminal-reserve borrowing. The plan must account final census/assembly/binding/policy/output-contract/later required rereads as well as capture.
programme_output_v2.publication: Each body has a prepublication cost/time snapshot only. The actual enclosing owner retains the publication costs/return, including receipt/seal/final policy publication and failures; no body claims its own finished I/O. Protected terminal reserve remains original and unavailable to normal capture/assembly. Both arms use the same manifest grammar and derived ceilings; no transfer of unused A/B allowance.

workspace_lifetime.capacity: One record per original arm replaces the previously untyped required closure body, not an additional publication. Its 11 closed fields use original Pin/OwnedPathIdentity/CostPrefix/UInt/Condition domains and must fit original M, member/depth/file/retention limits. It references, never copies, the earlier bounded subtree observation. Predeclare the actual closure write/readback and every later typed reread under the original full plan; no charge is dropped because the target is now named. All remaining capture/terminal effects and unknown native costs retain their original owners.
workspace_lifetime.failure: Failed/unknown subtree, anchor, identity, closure publication or later capture forbids successful closure/seal/promotion as applicable. Preserve actual failed prefixes, uncertain reservations and independently attempted cleanup. Never retry, fabricate a complete record or silently delete the source tree to claim workspace closure.
workspace_lifetime.lifetime: Workspace closure closes all original writers/descendants; it does not delete the readable source tree or release H read custody. Keep the original readonly/read-custody anchor or a separately qualified actual original-parent reopen capability through both-arm captures, inventories, receipts, seals and assembly. No path reconstruction, new root, renewed worker write authority or inherited-asset access is permitted. Removal/release occurs only in original H terminal cleanup after the full capture/assembly route no longer needs it, under the same E and original budgets.
workspace_lifetime.ordering: Earlier whole-arm subtree observation and retained workspace identity observation -> DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure -> DevelopmentCompletion -> DevelopmentPairClosure -> P01-P17. This record contains no future pair closure, programme manifest, source capture, seal, own Pin or own publication cost. observed_ns is the actual earlier observation and cost_prefix the actual earlier prefix before this closure publication.
workspace_lifetime.producer: The same actual original H DevelopmentAttemptHandle, after original worker natural exit0, complete original whole-arm descendant/write closure and the existing stream/worker/backend closure requirements. Capture this existing required closure product before its DevelopmentCompletion; then both completions precede pair closure. No extra closure publication is added.
workspace_lifetime.source_constructor_and_inverse: Within the existing fixed DevelopmentOwner.finish_pair_backend_v1 lifecycle, retain the actual attempt-owned workspace-closure publication slot before observation/validation/I/O. Only a completed same-owner CapturedRecord(kind=DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure) from the exact original observer and retained workspace produces attempt.descendant_workspace_closure. DevelopmentCompletion.descendant_and_workspace_closure equals that exact capture.pin; PairCompletionHandle.require_original and capture admission require the same actual capture object, kind, owner, earlier subtree capture, full closed body and the exact field inverses. No supplied record/Pin/allowed-owner set or live-capability deserialization fills the slot. An unfinished original slot remains retained without successful completion.
workspace_lifetime.subtree_inverse: subtree names the exact earlier SubtreeObservation for this original H DevelopmentAttempt capture: producer=host, scope=whole_arm, root=actual original worker identity, enumeration_complete=true, unresolved_count=0, excluded_live_worker=null and every actually enumerated member.state=exited_reaped. Require complete original qualified enumeration, never infer an empty list from wait/list absence. The natural exit and stream proofs stay separately required; a server_subtree/BackendClosure or prelaunch WorkspaceObservation cannot substitute.
workspace_lifetime.workspace_inverse: workspace names the exact earlier WorkspaceObservation for the same condition/pair/arm. retained_workspace_identity is a new actual directory OwnedPathIdentity for the same original OwnedPreparationPath object (device/inode/uid/parent ownership), with observed mode/clock retained; source-owned parent/anchor ancestry is required, not pathname equality. The record original_attempt, condition and owner_binding equal the same actual original H attempt, arm and owner.

server_closure: BackendClosure is produced while W is alive and proves its server subtree only. H subsequently observes W natural exit0 and the entire original arm group empty; no worker record asserts its own future exit and no server observation proves whole-group closure.
shutdown: Only previously healthy, acknowledged initialized server with no pending requests and enough original shutdown capacity can enter planned_protocol_shutdown. Any failure first irreversibly enters failure_cleanup. A later status0 after cleanup does not pass. No extra wall/CPU allocation, second signal, restarted server, profile relaxation or output-based retry.
streaming: Every actual W↔server physical read/write is charged once to the arm. Later H capture of the saved record is another real host read and is charged there. Reserve read length and retained allocation before call, retain EAGAIN/pending/unknown reservations, no zero-allowance EOF probe, record actual returned count, separately reserve final concatenation. Body/status errors keep original raw bytes/custody.
successor_http: BACKEND_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT: reserve raw bytes+hex/canonical/parser copies and bounded node traversal before allocation; response token counts never pay physical cost. Partial unknown reads keep full original hold. No new scope or deadline.
successor_preparation: PREPARATION_CONTRACT: same actual original host/arm objects, operation slots before effect, once-only owned cleanup, no missing future Pin in failure carrier.
v3_identity_and_snapshot_costs: Identity/base/snapshot publication reserves encoder/bytes/reads/writes/retention/clock/failure slots from the same original H or arm payer before effects; no model/reference budget changes. Immutable cost_prefix is a prior snapshot; its publication costs carry to live owner and later actual outcomes. Preidentity failure prevents preparation, prebase failure prevents server spawn, snapshot uncertainty poisons success and retains raw owner custody. Unknown close/write effects are not retried.
